subject: AWS Marketplace: metering acceptance & ledger onramp for BrightForge
messages:
From: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@amazon.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: aws-mpx-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightForge: MPX metering acceptance + ledger onramp

Hi Jordan / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. BrightForge is ready to move from sandbox to acceptance for AWS Marketplace metering. Before we flip the activation switch the MPX ops team needs a couple of things from Redwood to complete ledger onboarding and to ensure billing alignment:

- Final metering spec CSV (SKU -> dimension mapping, aggregation window)
- Signed SOW (we can accept the DocuSign envelope once Redwood confirms billing address and invoice contact)
- Confirmation of entitlement mapping: will you use account-level entitlements (AWS account link) or BrightForge-provided license keys?

I attached a sample MPX metering CSV (MPX_metering_spec_v1.csv) and a checklist.

Target timeline: acceptance cutover Wed 14 Jul PST if we have the signed SOW + spec by EOD Tue 13 Jul. If that timeline is tight, let me know the earliest date that works for you and BrightForge procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah Wong
AWS Partner SA — Marketplace
Attachments: MPX_metering_spec_v1.csv (CSV), MPX_onramp_checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: sarah.wong@amazon.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightForge: MPX metering acceptance + ledger onramp

Thanks Sarah — good summary.

Quick updates from Redwood:
- I uploaded our current mapping (SaaS_Marketplace_SOW_draft.pdf attached) and an initial entitlement preference: BrightForge wants account-level entitlements (they prefer AWS account linking to avoid key rotation).
- We can provide a cleaned MPX CSV by EOD Mon 12 Jul; Kim will validate SKU IDs against the product catalog.
- Invoice contact: billing@brightforge.com; billing address per the attached procurement_terms docx.

Action items for internal owners:
- Kimberly: please confirm SKU match and any normalization we should do before sending the CSV to MPX ops.
- Karthik: can you review whether account-link entitlements have any implications for our routing policies (regional mapping, fallback model variants)? I want to ensure we won't accidentally route to a non-compatible variant when AWS account-based entitlements trigger.

Jordan
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SaaS_Marketplace_SOW_draft.pdf, BrightForge_procurement_terms.docx

Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightForge: MPX metering acceptance + ledger onramp

Jordan / Sarah — quick procurement readout: BrightForge has returned a redline to section 4 (invoicing cadence) and requested net-60. They also asked for the billing contact to be set to accounts-payable@brightforge.com instead of billing@brightforge.com.

I reviewed the SKU list in SaaS_Marketplace_SOW_draft.pdf and flagged 3 SKUs that have changed IDs in our catalog (old: BF-GEN-1 -> new: BF-GEN-A). I attached a normalized CSV (MPX_metering_spec_v1.csv) with a comment column for each change.

A couple of notes for MPX ops:
- We will use account-level entitlements per BrightForge preference, but BrightForge also requests a secondary license-key fallback for test environments.
- Please ensure the aggregation window is hourly for the "inference_token" dimension — BrightForge's procurement wants hourly usage lines to match their internal ledger.

If MPX ops needs a call to confirm ledger field names (invoice_reference, partner_sku, usage_window_start) I'm happy to jump on a short sync next week.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MPX_metering_spec_v1.csv (CSV, normalized), procurement_redline_summary.docx

Subject: RE: BrightForge: MPX metering acceptance + ledger onramp

Hi everyone,

Confirming we received the normalized MPX CSV and procurement redline summary. MPX ops notes:
- Ledger fields look good; we'll accept hourly aggregation for inference_token as requested.
- For account-level entitlements, please ensure your partner SKU fields map to partner_sku in the CSV (we flagged the BF-GEN-A mapping and will reconcile on our side).
- DocuSign envelope ABC123 is queued; we need an authorized signer to complete the SOW. Once signed we will schedule the acceptance cutover — earliest available window: Thu 15 Jul 02:00-04:00 PST.

Next steps:
1) Redwood to confirm authorized signer and update DocuSign (link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123)
2) MPX ops to perform a dry-run ingestion on Wed 14 Jul 03:00 PST against the staging ledger
3) Production cutover Thu 15 Jul 02:00-04:00 PST if dry-run passes

Thanks,
MPX Ops Team
Amazon Web Services
